summary.headline: Ganesh Housing Q2 FY27 PAT rose to INR67 crores on INR121 crores land-sale revenue; FY27 guidance of INR1,000-1,200 crores revenue reaffirmed.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue was INR121 crores, all from project land sales, with EBITDA of INR98 crores (80.7% margin) and PAT of INR67 crores (EPS INR8.02), up 59% QoQ but slightly lower YoY against a high base of INR174 crores revenue and INR108 crores PAT. Management attributed the QoQ margin swing to Q1 carrying a high-cost inherited land basis and a one-time tax charge on the One 91 Thaltej land sale. H1 revenue was about INR402 crores, EBITDA INR208 crores and PAT about INR109 crores, and management reaffirmed FY27 guidance of INR1,000-1,200 crores revenue and INR300-325 crores PAT, which depends on H2 completions and land sales. Million Minds Tower 1 leasing reached 68.4% of leasable carpet area, and Malabar Retreat is 87% complete with possession targeted for 15 January 2027.

financial_highlights.change: Lower YoY vs INR174 crores in Q2 FY26
Margin up from 39.3% in Q1 FY27

financial_highlights.value: INR67 crores, 55.1% PAT margin, EPS INR8.02
financial_highlights.change: Up 59% QoQ from INR42 crores; down YoY from INR108 crores

financial_highlights.metric: Contracted rent roll, Million Minds Tower 1

financial_highlights.value: INR132 crores; expected receivables booked and unbooked INR305 crores

segments.name: Land sales / project sales
segments.commentary: Entire Q2 FY27 revenue of INR121 crores came from project land sales; company says reported quarterly revenue depends on project completion under Ind AS 115.

segments.name: Million Minds Tower 1 (leasing)
segments.commentary: 68.4% of leasable carpet area let across 15 deals; 4.21 lakh sq ft let of 6.16 lakh sq ft. Average rent INR110.20/sq ft per month; latest deals at about INR122.4. Lease rentals expected from Q4 FY27; fully let rent potential about INR84 crores a year.

segments.name: Malabar Retreat (residential)
segments.commentary: 87% complete; about 50% of units booked (76 units; 53% by carpet area). Priced at top of micro market with no discounting; possession intimation 15 January 2027, BU expected mid-February 2027.

segments.name: Million Minds Phase 2 (Tower 2)
segments.commentary: Plan of 6.6 lakh sq ft leasable carpet on about 14.5 lakh sq ft construction submitted for approval; target rent about INR118/sq ft, implying about INR94 crores annual rent at full occupancy. Bhumi Pujan targeted 24 November 2026.

segments.name: Million Minds residential Phase 1
segments.commentary: About 9 lakh sq ft, around 334 units (3 BHK), two towers; expected GDV INR500 crores; launch planned Q4 FY27, timeline 2 to 2.5 years.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue guidance of INR1,000-1,200 crores and PAT of INR300-325 crores reaffirmed; H2 expected to be much stronger, with Malabar Retreat completion and other project and land sales in Q3-Q4.
Management expects Malabar Retreat to sell about 75% (possibly nearly all) of unsold units by March 2027.
Tower 1 rentals to begin from Q4 FY27; expects about 90% of Tower 1 let by March 2027.
FY28 year-on-year guidance to be given in Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28.
Godhavi monetization plan (mix of plotted development, land sales and project development) to be updated later in FY27; company now expects about 6 more months for concrete plans.
RERA timeline for Malabar Retreat runs to September 2027; company aims to complete about 6 months early.
capex_capacity: Million Minds Tower 1: final-stage fit-outs and landscaping; lease rentals from Q4 FY27.

Million Minds Tower 2: 18-24 month build, fit-out-ready window May-November 2028, pre-leasing from late 2027; company also cited 24-28 months in call. Construction approval pending; contractor appointed for civil work.
Malabar Retreat: about 87% complete, with about 13% remaining; soft possession 15 January 2027, BU mid-February 2027.

Fully paid land reserve of 513 acres (about 405 acres at Godhavi, about 65 acres at Million Minds, balance around Ahmedabad); new large parcels under negotiation/acquisition with partial payments made, not included in 513 acres.

Planned Million Minds SEZ: 64 acres, about 18 million sq ft across 7 office phases plus residential, retail (mall about 4.5 lakh sq ft), hotel/convention (about 5 lakh sq ft) and service apartments; about 63,000 jobs at maturity.
demand_pricing: Malabar Retreat: about 76 units booked (50% by units, 53% by carpet area); about 30-40 units sold in last 4 months per management; priced at top of micro market with no discounts.
Tower 1 rents rose from about INR90/sq ft (2025 leases) to about INR115 (2026) to above INR122 (Q2 deals); building average INR110.20/sq ft.
Co-working concentration fell: three operators held 28.7% of space let, versus about 36% a quarter earlier; all three new Q2 deals are direct corporate tenants.
Q2 Tower 1 leases: LOIs/leases with Airtel, Conga Software, Flagler Health and iBase-t; new deals about 84,000 sq ft; contracted leases 9 to 10 years with 5-year lock-in for most.
Ahmedabad housing: 14,300 units sold in 9 months to September 2026 (up 2%); weighted average price INR4,837/sq ft (up 3.7%); unsold inventory about 38,700 units.

qa_highlights.question: Where will H2 revenue of INR600-800 crores come from, given Malabar Retreat's unsold inventory and minimal rent in FY27? Also what are lock-in, rent-free and deposit terms for new tenants?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the H2 gap would be filled by Malabar Retreat completion plus pipeline project and land sales expected in Q3, or by Q4 at latest. Leases are mostly 9-10 years with 5-year-plus lock-ins; rent-free and deposit terms were not detailed in the call.

qa_highlights.question: What is the planned split of the 405-acre Godhavi land between plotted development, land sales and project development, and when will monetization be announced?
qa_highlights.answer: Mix not yet finalized and depends on infrastructure around Godhavi; management now expects about 6 more months before concrete monetization plans are announced.

qa_highlights.question: Why is Malabar Retreat sales velocity low despite no discounting, and what is the plan for the unsold half?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the market has been in a lull for 3-4 quarters with premium units selling most; bookings picked up with 30-40 units in the last 4 months; rainy-season slowdown was also cited. Target is to sell nearly all, or at least 75%, by March 2027.

qa_highlights.question: Size, pricing, GDV, approval status and funding timing for Million Minds residential Phase 1?
qa_highlights.answer: About 9 lakh sq ft, around 334 3 BHK units across 2 towers, GDV about INR500 crores, timeline 2-2.5 years, launch Q4 FY27. Approval status and SEZ versus non-SEZ split were not clearly answered.

qa_highlights.question: How will the company fund the projects and what peak debt is expected?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it will take some leverage but not at historical ratios; existing borrowings are against discounted lease rentals, and residential projects are funded by bookings and already-paid land, with land monetization and lease rentals as further cash sources. No peak-debt figure was given.

qa_highlights.question: Tower 2 approvals, Tower 1 original versus actual schedule, and why Tower 2 target rent (INR118) is below Tower 1 (INR122)?
qa_highlights.answer: Management called INR118 conservative and said it could reach INR130-140/sq ft. Bhumi Pujan on 24 November needs no approval; construction start depends on approvals in process. Schedule was not compared to Tower 1's original timeline in detail.

qa_highlights.question: Malabar Retreat progress: how can the remaining 13% be completed by 15 January possession and mid-February BU?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said external facade is about 90% done, MEP about 60-70%, and painting has started on one tower; remaining work is shorter than the initial construction phase. Soft possession 15 January and BU mid-February are on track; RERA deadline is September 2027.

qa_highlights.question: Tower 1 leasing went from 43% to about 68%; how does this reconcile with only 84,000 sq ft added this quarter, and will LOIs and signed leases be reported separately?
qa_highlights.answer: 43% earlier plus 17% under discussion became signed deals, so the 68% figure reflects completed signings only. Remaining space is for large negotiations. Separate reporting of LOIs versus leases was not committed.

risks_watch: H2 revenue gap: guidance of INR1,000-1,200 crores needs H2 revenue of roughly INR600-800 crores; management relies on Malabar Retreat completion (BU mid-February 2027) plus land and project sales in Q3 or by Q4, with no named transactions.
Malabar Retreat sales velocity: about 50% sold by units, with 30-40 units booked in the last 4 months; target of 75% or nearly all unsold units by March 2027 needs to be tracked against bookings.
Million Minds Tower 1: 68.4% let versus 90% target by March 2027; remaining about 1.95 lakh sq ft held for one or two large tenants, and rentals start Q4 FY27.
Tower 2 timing: construction approval still pending while Bhumi Pujan is set for 24 November 2026; the 18-24 month build and May-November 2028 fit-out window depend on approvals.
Rising rate environment: RBI repo hike to 5.5% on 7 October 2026 and a tightening stance; management plans some leverage for Tower 2 and residential projects, with no peak-debt figure given.
Godhavi monetization plan delayed about 6 months to an update later in FY27; FY28 guidance due in Q4 FY27 or Q1 FY28.
key_quotes: We expect a much different and better performance during H2 and hence, our guidance which we have given in Q1 this year for FY27 of INR1,000 crores to INR1,200 crores revenue and INR300 crores to INR325 crores PAT is reaffirmed.
Our balance sheet, on the other hand, is almost debt free. So a rate cycle that squeezes others gives us room to be selective.
We should be honest that in a market with such kind of a supply, pre -leased Grade A space is what wins.
The leverage, we have always said that we have been a near zero debt company for a long period of time.
summary.management_tone: Management was confident on the project pipeline, Tower 1 leasing and Malabar Retreat timelines, but cautious and vague on H2 revenue sources, Godhavi timing and debt levels. Several answers were non-specific on land sale names, peak debt and LOI reporting.

rows.label: Godhavi monetization plan update

tone.note: Management was confident on Malabar Retreat timelines, Tower 1 leasing and the project pipeline, but cautious and vague on H2 revenue sources, Godhavi timing and peak debt; analysts pushed on H2 revenue gap and sales velocity.
